player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id}. You are playing the Memory Game.
Your goal is to match more pairs of cards on the board, than your opponent.
On your turn, select two cards to flip by entering the row and column numbers of the first and second card respectively like '[0 1 1 0]', where the first card is in row 0 and column 1, and the second card is in row 1 and column 0.
If the two cards match, you get a point and the cards remain face up. If they do not match, the cards are flipped back face down, e.g. '.'.
The game ends when all pairs have been matched.

board.current_board: Komiti Faatino o loʻo iai nei: {board}

invalid_move.wrong_format: E le sa'o se faatulagaga o taamilosaga. e lei tali mai lava le tagata taaalo {player_id} i ni faasinoga talafeagai ua tusia i puipui sikuea.
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: E lē saʻo le taalo. Na filifilia e le tagata taaalo {player_id} se tulaga i fafo atu o tapulaa.
invalid_move.same_card_twice: E lē saʻo le taalo. Na filifilia faalua e le tagata taaalo {player_id} se kata lava lea e tasi.
invalid_move.already_matched: E lē aogā le taʻaloga. Ua filifilia e se tagata taaalo {player_id} ni kata ua uma ona fetaui, pe lua foʻi ia pepa.

game_message.cards_match: The cards selected by Player {player_id} at positions [{r1} {c1}] and [{r2} {c2}] match!
game_message.cards_no_match: The cards selected by Player {player_id} do not match. Cards at positions [{r1} {c1}] and [{r2} {c2}] are {pos1} and {pos2} respectively.

outcome.draw: Na tutusa uma le numera o paʻu pepa na maua e tagata taaalo.
outcome.turn_limit: Ua oʻo i le taimi o le turn. O le mea ua mavae le taaloga. Na faʻaopoopo e le Pila 0 {score_0} fuainumera, na faʻaopoopo e le Pila 1 {score_1} fuainumera.
